checks.label: Count up from the lower reading, through zero: −5 to +3 is 8, −4 to +2 is 6, −12 to +6 is 18, −20 to +4 is 24, −25 to +25 is 50 and −1.5 to +2.3 is 3.8 (the two sizes added); −18 to −5 is 13 and −8 to −3 is 5, never reaching zero; counting one degree at a time gives the same whole-number gaps; each puzzle accepts only its answer
Differences between values are always positive: every gap in this lesson comes out above zero, counted from either reading, and no answer with a minus sign is accepted

Size leaves the sign off: the size of −12 is 12, of −5 and +5 is 5, and of 0 is 0; −7 is further from zero than +5 though +5 is higher; a gap across zero is the two sizes added (20 + 4 = 24, 25 + 25 = 50)
All standard reefer containers are built to maintain a temperature between +25 °C and −25 °C: step 10 asks for that range, and counted up from −25 through zero to +25 it is 25 + 25 = 50 degrees

The meat room marker snaps to whole steps of 2 degrees between −24 and +8, and 24 is accepted only with it on −20 (left above it, the hint says drag it down; gone past it, up); as drawn, −20 sits below zero and +4 above it, and the bracket between them spans 24 degrees of the scale

Every demonstration has finished arriving within 4.5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion within 2.5 s; hops along the line start at least 0.2 s apart
